pending.title: Last action not confirmed
pending.help: Retry it before doing anything else for this member. A retry sends the same request, so it is applied at most once.

pending.discardConfirm: Discard only after checking the member's points history. If the action went through, it stays applied.
pending.notApplied: The last action was not applied: {{reason}}
